verdict.rationale: The self-hosting docs list integrations with Azure OpenAI and Ollama, which supports the bring-your-own-backend half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows LobeChat itself displaying token usage or cost per model or per conversation. The Langfuse listing is an external observability tool, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: any documented token-usage view, cost tracking per model, cost tracking per conversation, explicit API-key or subscription configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I bring my own API keys or subscriptions and can see token usage and cost per model or per conversation

citations.quote: LobeHub can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, giving you complete control over your data, customization, and deployment environment.
